meta.name: browser
meta.description: Drives a real browser through the omowright library from the js eval kernel: sites the user is already signed into, forms and clicks, JS-rendered pages, screenshots, web QA, extension popups, a human handoff for login, CAPTCHA or OTP, and a browser you own for scraping, bot-scored targets, network capture and QA traces. Use for any interactive browser task; not for a plain search or an unblocked static fetch.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 自动操作真实浏览器,完成点击、填表、截图与页面检查
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果经常需要让程序替你在真实网站上点击、填表或采集数据。
copy.tagline_en: Automate a real browser to click, fill forms, and capture screenshots
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need a program to click, fill forms, or scrape real websites.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 通过 omowright 驱动一个真实浏览器:在你已登录的站点上导航、点击、填表、截图、做网页 QA;遇到登录、验证码或 OTP 时可请你人工接手。
howto.when: 当你要求做交互式浏览器任务(如点击、填表、截图等)时接管;纯搜索或未被拦截的静态抓取不在范围内。

say.text: 用我平时用的浏览器打开这个网站,并截图给我。
say.note: 走 attached 引擎,复用你已有的登录状态。

say.text: 在这个页面上填好表单并提交,然后确认结果。
say.note: 碰到验证码或 OTP 它会请你人工处理。

say.text: 这个站点会拦爬虫,用独立浏览器帮我抓取。

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude drives a real browser through the omowright library: navigating sites you are already signed into, clicking, filling forms, taking screenshots and running web QA; it can hand login, CAPTCHA or OTP off to you.
howto.when_en: It takes over for interactive browser tasks such as clicking, filling forms or screenshots; a plain search or an unblocked static fetch is out of scope.

say_en.text: Open this site in the browser I normally use and screenshot it.
say_en.note: Uses the attached engine with your existing logins.

say_en.text: Fill in this form and submit it, then confirm the result.
say_en.note: It may ask you to handle a CAPTCHA yourself.

say_en.text: This site blocks scrapers - use a separate browser to scrape it.
say_en.note: Switches to the owned CloakBrowser engine.
